description: This file contains API client functions for authentication-related operations, including fetching user organizations by email and logging in with email and password. It imports configuration, utility functions, and URL resolution helpers, and exports two main asynchronous functions.

methods.name: fetchUserOrganizationsByEmail
methods.description: Fetches user organizations based on email, handling different response statuses and returning organization data or empty list.

methods.name: loginWithOrgEmailPassword
methods.description: Performs login with email and password, validating tenant salt, constructing request, handling response, and returning token and payload.
